goal: Add and export the pure domain function summarizeInventory(state) from src/domain/orders.mjs. It must derive { totalUnits, occupiedSkus } from state.stockBySku, work for different states without hardcoded values, preserve every existing operation, and include a focused domain test. Do not change application or api.
acceptanceCriteria: The domain exports summarizeInventory(state) and returns exactly { totalUnits, occupiedSkus }.
The values are derived from stockBySku for empty, occupied, and post-cancellation states; no hardcoded fixture result is accepted.
Existing domain behavior and baseline tests remain green, with a focused test for the new helper.
